SEBI Appeal No. 7066 of 2026 Filed by Saksham Puri: What the Notice Says

Last updated: 25 Sep 2026

S
Samjho Content Team
Finance and policy experts with 5+ years of experience helping Indians understand money, documents and government schemes.

Quick Summary

SEBI has listed Appeal No. 7066 of 2026 on its website. The appeal was filed by Saksham Puri. It was published on 22 September 2026. The notice does not explain the case details or any outcome.

Why It Matters

What Happened

SEBI posted a new appeal on its official website. The appeal is numbered 7066 of 2026.

It was filed by a person named Saksham Puri. The page went live on 22 September 2026.

The notice itself is very short. It only shows the appeal number and the name of the person who filed it.

It does not describe the dispute, the parties involved, or any decision.

What Changes

Not much changes for the general public right now. The source page is just a record of an appeal being filed with SEBI.

It does not spell out any rule change, penalty, or relief. So you cannot tell from this page what the outcome will be.

Think of it like a case number board outside a court. It tells you a matter exists. It does not tell you the judgment.

What You Need to Do

If you are not linked to this case, you do not need to do anything. This notice is not aimed at the public at large.

If you are a party to the matter, wait for SEBI's official communication to you. Do not act on rumours or social media posts.

You can track updates on SEBI's website under its enforcement orders section.

Always check the original page before you rely on any claim about this appeal.

Deadline

Not specified in the official source. The notice lists no date for a hearing, a reply, or a final order.

Keep an eye on SEBI's website for any later update on this appeal.

A Simple Takeaway

This is a routine listing of an appeal on SEBI's site. The public page gives only the appeal number and the name Saksham Puri.

For the full facts, you must wait for the detailed order or a follow-up notice from SEBI.

Important Dates

  • The appeal was published on the SEBI website on 22 September 2026.

FAQs

Who filed this appeal?

The appeal was filed by Saksham Puri, as stated in the official SEBI page.
